title: Krakus's Music Discs
description: This project adds new music discs what are mostly for fun.
body:
![Krakus's Music Discs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e53c9d566e7f113f06cda333457dcb9c751231c.png)
Have you ever dreamed about the ability to listen to ''Unity'', ''Xenogenesis'', ''Raining Tacos'' or..... 
''brainrot rap''....?
Or did you ever wanted to eat music discs?

But If yes then i want to introduce you to the mod ''Krakus's Music Discs'' where all your dreams are coming true!
